'''Aine 27 (April 11)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[999 NE]] - [[Mat]] is visited by [[Elayne]], [[Egwene]], and [[Nynaeve]]. He is given a letter for [[Morgase]] and a pass from the [[Amyrlin]]. Mat then flees from the [[White Tower]] that night, meeting [[Thomdril Merrilin|Thom Merrilin]], and departing for [[Caemlyn]] with him.
*[[999 NE]] - Egwene, Elayne, and Nynaeve board a ship bound for [[Tear]] in order to hunt the [[Black Ajah]].
